Jewellery Care

To maintain the appearance and shine of your artificial jewellery:

Keep away from water, perfume, deodorant and other chemicals.
Avoid prolonged exposure to sweat and moisture.
Store separately in a dry, airtight jewellery box or pouch.
Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth after use.
Avoid dropping or rubbing the jewellery against hard surfaces.

Note: This is fashion/artificial jewellery. The stones and metal finish are decorative and are not claimed to be precious gemstones or solid gold.

🧼 Care Instructions

To maintain the appearance and shine of your jewellery:

Keep away from water and moisture.
Avoid direct contact with perfume, deodorant, creams and other cosmetics.
Remove before bathing, swimming or exercising.
Store separately in a jewellery box or soft pouch.
Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight and humidity.
Handle the stones and dangling elements carefully.

Note: This is artificial/imitation jewellery and is intended for fashion and occasion wear.
